problem_text:
A shipping company must allocate cargo space for six distinct categories of freight, each necessitating six sequential handling stages for preparation. The revenue generated per ton for each freight category is listed as follows:
* For Freight Alpha, revenue is 9.591 per ton
* For Freight Beta, revenue is 5.898 per ton
* For Freight Gamma, revenue is 6.881 per ton
* For Freight Delta, revenue is 7.009 per ton
* For Freight Epsilon, revenue is 12.213 per ton
* For Freight Zeta, revenue is 14.628 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each stage is detailed below:
*For Freight Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.575 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.284 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.683 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.278 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.199 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.539 (ton-hours)
*For Freight Beta, Stage 1 consumes 1.336 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.909 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.82 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.255 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.349 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.208 (ton-hours)
*For Freight Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 1.664 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.563 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.67 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.461 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.657 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.667 (ton-hours)
*For Freight Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.884 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.997 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.479 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.82 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.195 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.269 (ton-hours)
*For Freight Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.254 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.355 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.261 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.564 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.672 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.329 (ton-hours)
*For Freight Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.367 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.022 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.63 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.026 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.487 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.801 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling time for Stage 1 cannot surpass 238.098 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 2 cannot surpass 224.835 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 3 cannot surpass 128.435 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 4 cannot surpass 229.685 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 5 cannot surpass 181.742 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 6 cannot surpass 144.275 hours

Given the imperative to ensure that for each individual stage—Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4, Stage 5, and Stage 6—the total processing duration remains within the stipulated available capacity, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each freight category to maximize overall revenue.
